findings.claim: Docstring sentence violates the rule 'no more than a single sub-clause per sentence' by combining multiple dependent clauses and parenthetical reasoning.
findings.quote:
Fail loud on an all-dead result: no live segment means nothing for the
segmenter to anchor to (apply_replay_mask rejects an all-True mask anyway), so
a fully-dead mask is almost always a bad vote input rather than a real answer.
findings.suggested_fix: Split into simpler sentences: 'Fail loud on an all-dead result: no live segment means nothing for the segmenter to anchor to. The apply_replay_mask function rejects an all-True mask anyway. A fully-dead mask is almost always a bad vote input rather than a real answer.'
